Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the partnership here. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a final go-live / rollout planning call to walk through the cutover steps, fallback policies, and owner responsibilities. Recommended agenda (30–45 min):

- Quick rollcall & success criteria
- Cutover timeline and exact blackout window
- Owners for cutover tasks and immediate rollback/fallback owners
- Verification steps & smoke tests post-cutover
- Contingency plan and rollback triggers
- Q&A and next steps

Can we do one of the following slots (all PT)?
- Mon 3/22 09:00–09:45
- Mon 3/22 13:00–13:45
- Tue 3/23 10:00–10:45

I've looped in Mateo (SE) to cover the technical runbook and Dev for procurement/contract questions. I've attached the latest cutover plan (v2) and a draft runbook with fallback owners.

If none of those work, tell me preferred windows and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0132

Thanks Marissa — confirmed for Mon 3/22 15:00 PT. I'll present the technical runbook and cover:

- Rollback detection signals (error rate spike, 5xx, tokenization failures, end-to-end smoke test failures)
- KV cache retention: default TTL is ~10 minutes post-session; for this cutover we recommend invalidating cache on node restart and a 15-minute verification window
- Rollback steps and owners: Dev (primary rollback), James/Acme (coordinated rollback), Mateo (verify system health)

I'll prepare a 7-minute deck + a live runbook walkthrough. Attaching a very short fallback owners spreadsheet.
